abilities.name: Puffshroom Frenzy
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly **^^Moonclan^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: A Prod in the Right Direction
abilities.effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
